title: Combat-loading plans repeatedly revised

paragraphs.text: The warning order required combat loading. The embarkation officer was on leave when it arrived, and the team faced short notice and limited experience. Cargo totals changed after loading plans were completed; supplies for other 1st Marine Division units also had to be accommodated when space allowed.
